title: 5 Levels of "Happy" in English (Level 5 Is an Idiom) #shorts
description:
"Happy" in English, from Level 1 to Level 5:
• Level 1 – Happy: I'm happy today.
• Level 2 – Delighted: I'm delighted with my gift.
• Level 3 – Overjoyed: We were overjoyed at the news.
• Level 4 – Ecstatic: I was ecstatic when we won.
• Level 5 – the idiom: I'm over the moon!

Levels 1 to 5 are our own ladder: from the everyday word up to the idiom native speakers use.
